# Convex Documentation

- [Functions](https://docs.convex.dev/functions/overview.md): Write functions to define your server behavior

- [Schemas](https://docs.convex.dev/database/schemas.md): Schema validation keeps your Convex data neat and tidy. It also gives you end-to-end TypeScript type safety!
- [Data Types](https://docs.convex.dev/database/types.md): Supported data types in Convex documents
- [Writing Data](https://docs.convex.dev/database/writing-data.md): Insert, update, and delete data in Convex database tables
